dct_description_sm: To better understand radiative forcing in the Beaufort Sea region a dataset that describes cloud cover conditions is highly valuable. We had the opportunity to deploy an allsky camera, which would take imagery which could be post-processed to provide a cloud fraction time series dataset.  This dataset complements the radiation and FLIR datasets (CCIN 11622 and 11623) collected during the 2012 JOIS cruice.  A set of manual meterological observations is also included to complement the dataset.
dct_title_s: All-sky Camera Imagery Joint Ocean Ice Study (JOIS) 2012 (University of Manitoba)
